about: C10: what agent-judge requires of every repo in JUDGE_REPO_DIR and JUDGE_INFRA_REPOS. The verify hook finds a repo root by these files (judge/hooks/verify.py find_repo) and runs its sanitizer there; the render_and_diff and check_sanitized probes resolve their scripts under JUDGE_REPO_DIR only (judge/probes/probe.py). Versioning: minor = a new optional file; major = a new required file, a renamed path, or changed exit codes.
